I see that you have `@playwright/test` and `playwright` installed. You don't need to have `playwright` installed, the `@playwright/test` package is enough. Could you try the following?

    npm uninstall playwright
    npx playwright test --ui

Also it seems like you still are on the old version - `npx playwright --version` should confirm that. Try deleting the `node_modules` folder and running `npm install` again.
I hadn't changed anything. It was working last night, broke today. Now working again upon removal and reinstall. Thanks none the less
